newsitem.title: CANADA: Caledonia announces new Zambia results.
newsitem.headline: Caledonia announces new Zambia results.

text.p: Caledonia Mining Corp said on Thursday that drilling at its cobalt property in Nama, Zambia has expanded the discovery to the west.

All 16 new holes on its anomaly C cobalt discovery area intersected significant mineralization, with wide intersections in the range of 30 to 86 metres in eight of the holes, the company said in a statement.
Relatively high grade intersections continue to be found in the centre of the deposit heading towards the west, where the deposit remains open, the company said.
Grades ranged from 0.017 percent cobalt and 0.195 percent cobalt with widths ranging from two metres to 86 metres.
A cutoff grade of 0.015 percent cobalt was used to determine intersection widths.
